conventions: chapterNumber is the book chapter number (1-based, same as chapter.number in the editions); paragraphIndex is 0-based within the chapter; startOffset/endOffset are UTF-16 code-unit offsets (end exclusive) into the paragraph string; text must equal paragraph.slice(start,end). Coordinates in "old" are against baseline (live) modern-en; in "new" against the accepted candidate. Rulings never move a link to a different paragraph. "structuralPackage" gives the paragraph index in the moby-dick-structural modern-en (chapters 56, 57, 73 only: index-1).

rulingValues.UNCHANGED: paragraph byte-identical in candidate; link untouched
rulingValues.KEEP: paragraph changed but the same mention still sits at the same coordinates with the same text
rulingValues.RE-POINT: same mention (same clause) now at "new" coordinates; text form may change (Peleg->Captain Peleg, Captain Ahab->Ahab)
rulingValues.DROP: no corresponding same-clause mention survives; remove the link (see RULINGS.md)
